A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you
hit download.

Little details, cleared up.

Which video qualities can I download?

ClipNest lists the formats actually returned by YouTube for your video. That can include 360p, 720p, 1080p, or higher, depending on the original upload. It never upscales a video. Some formats need FFmpeg to combine video and audio.

How fast will my download be?

The server downloads up to eight fragments in parallel when supported. The progress panel shows real bytes, speed, and an estimated time. After processing, your browser saves the file. Source limits, server bandwidth, and your connection affect the speed.

Can I save only the audio?

Yes. Switch to Audio to see the available original audio streams, plus an MP3 conversion option if the connected server has FFmpeg. Converting audio does not improve its source quality.

Why do I need to connect a server?

This hosted page needs a download server to discover formats and prepare files. The complete server and this website are included in the setup download. Run them locally with Docker, or connect an HTTPS server in Server setup. The preview only demonstrates the interface.

Where are my files and history stored?

On an account-enabled server, your history is saved in the database and survives app restarts. Local prototype mode keeps history in this browser. Prepared files expire after the server’s retention window, normally 30 minutes. Save a ready file to your device before it expires.

YOUR PERSONAL DOWNLOAD ENGINE

Let’s get connected.

Video processing runs on your server. Connect it here, or run the complete app on your computer.

Starting from scratch?

Download the app, unzip it, then run this command in its folder:

node scripts/init-local.mjs && docker compose up --build -d

Open http://localhost:8787 to use the full app locally. Docker Desktop is required.

Download website + server
OR CONNECT AN EXISTING SERVER

Use HTTPS for a server connected to this hosted page.

The token stays in this tab’s session. Never sent to a third-party download service.

For a remote server, add this website’s exact origin to ALLOWED_ORIGINS and set an API_TOKEN. Full instructions are in the download.

 A SMALL TOOL FOR YOUR OFFLINE LIFE

Meet ClipNest.

A straightforward interface for discovering YouTube video qualities and preparing downloads with your own server.

Built with vanilla JavaScript, Node.js, yt-dlp, and FFmpeg. No ads, paid download APIs, analytics, or artificial download progress.

The sample preview is illustrative. Real analysis and downloads require the included server. Only download content you have permission to save.
